'''Recycloppers''' were a species of [[Sentience/Legends|nonsentient]] [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] that dwelled in the [[Water/Legends|freshwaters]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology and appearance==
The recylcoppers were spiny, rotund, cyclopean, omnivorous [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] that lived in the [[Water/Legends|freshwaters]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="FOTW" /> The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used them as a sort of garbage disposal, as they could eat virtually anything. Recycloppers were often often kept in an aquarium.<ref name="FOTW" />

*''[[Episode I Adventures 10: Festival of Warriors]]''
